name: Translation 即时翻译
description: Translation 即时翻译 —— 多引擎翻译插件：支持 OpenAI 兼容大模型、DeepL、百度、有道、阿里云与本地 CLI 代理，含流式输出、输入即译、引擎管理与翻译历史。所有网络请求由内置 Go 侧车发出（浏览器沙箱的 CSP 禁止前端直连外部端点，且 host.network 白名单最多 8 个固定 origin，无法满足用户自填端点）。API Key 经系统密钥库（Windows DPAPI / macOS Keychain / Linux secret-tool）加密后落盘到插件数据目录，不可用时降级为机器绑定 AES-256-GCM 并在界面明确警示。引擎配置、翻译历史与界面偏好统一存放在 <插件数据目录>/translation.db（SQLite），由侧车写入；前端运行在 opaque origin 沙箱中，不接触磁盘，也不使用 localStorage。翻译历史（原文与译文）以明文保存在本地 SQLite（translation.db）中，卸载插件后仍会保留，可在「历史」页随时清空；侧车会直连用户在引擎配置中填写的任意 HTTP/HTTPS 端点。
releaseNotes: 0.2.2：补齐商店上架整改 —— 新增 Apache-2.0 LICENSE 文件；发布产物改由 GitHub Actions 从 tag 用固定 Go 工具链构建（保证二进制内嵌的 vcs.revision 可在公开仓库中核验）；统一 assets 换行符为 LF 使本地与 CI 打包字节一致；候选元数据改为 DBX Store 扁平 schema 并使用 release 资产的绝对 HTTPS 地址；在 listing 描述中明确披露网络面与隐私面。

en.name: Translation
en.description: Translation — multi-engine translation plugin: OpenAI-compatible LLMs, DeepL, Baidu, Youdao, Alibaba Cloud and local CLI proxies, with streaming output, translate-as-you-type, engine management and translation history. All HTTP requests are issued by the bundled Go sidecar (the browser sandbox CSP forbids direct calls, and the host.network allowlist cannot express user-supplied endpoints). API keys are encrypted with the OS keychain (Windows DPAPI / macOS Keychain / Linux secret-tool) before being written to the plugin data directory, falling back to machine-bound AES-256-GCM with an explicit in-UI warning. Engine config, history and preferences live in <plugin-data>/translation.db (SQLite), written by the sidecar; the frontend runs in an opaque-origin sandbox and never touches disk or localStorage. Translation history (source and target text) is stored in plaintext in a local SQLite file (translation.db) that survives uninstallation and can be cleared at any time from the History tab; the sidecar connects directly to whatever HTTP/HTTPS endpoint the user configures per engine.
